request_master.source_policy: GameWithを正本候補として全128件を照合。重要条件はStratsWiki/Fogu/GameCalc/AppMedia/WikiWiki等でクロスチェックし、不一致は個別provenanceへ記録。GameCalc/WikiWiki単独では確定しない。

primary: GameWith recent request list and individual request pages
source_strategy.rule: Prefer concrete request/item pages and agreement across independent sources. Preserve conflicts and confidence instead of silently normalizing.

request_master.spoiler_match_policy: Partial title suggestions require requester + >=4 normalized chars + unique candidate. Without requester, only exact title matches are eligible.
known_conflicts: WikiWiki has Isaac windmill use as 200?; GameCalc/GameWith agree on 100, so 100 is retained.
Sania title appears as ハンカチ on current GameWith request page and ブローチ on some related/source pages; ハンカチ is canonical, ブローチ is a hidden alias.
Charles shop material counts differ across source snapshots; current GameWith list 99/5/5 is retained.
cross_source_notes: GameWith is the canonical candidate for the 128-request index and detailed Japanese requirements.
StratsWiki/Fogu are strong independent cross-checks; GameCalc/AppMedia/WikiWiki are supplementary.
Question-marked or conflicting values are not silently promoted; conflicts are retained in provenance.
request_master.final_structure_policy: Keep base objective types item_quantity/action_count/money_amount/check. Split AND composites into independently trackable objectives. Keep OR choices as one objective with alternatives; use optional quality/category metadata.

objective_schema.choice_semantics: alternatives are any-of within one objective; never split into multiple required objectives

player_state_migration.purpose: Detect legacy canonical request objectives without overwriting user-customized objectives, then migrate progress safely.
